test_SelectFromModel_threshold_string: test SelectFromModel with string threshold like '0.5*mean' to select features above half the mean importance
test_SelectFromModel_max_features: test SelectFromModel with max_features parameter to limit the number of selected features
test_SelectFromModel_prefit: test SelectFromModel with prefit=True to use a pre-fitted estimator without refitting
test_SelectFromModel_importance_getter: test SelectFromModel with custom importance_getter to extract feature importance from pipeline steps
test_SelectFromModel_partial_fit: test SelectFromModel partial_fit with SGDClassifier for incremental feature selection
